key_features.title: Simple Syntax
key_features.content: Crystal's syntax is heavily inspired by Ruby, so it is natural to read and easy to write.

key_features.title: Static Type Checking
key_features.content: Crystal is statically type checked with built-in type inference, so type errors are caught early.

key_features.title: Null Reference Checks
key_features.content: All types are non-nilable in Crystal, so the compiler checks for null references at compile time.

key_features.title: Concurrency Model
key_features.content: Crystal has built in concurrency primitives, called fibers, to achieve concurrency.

key_features.title: C-Interopability
key_features.content: Crystal has dedicated syntax to easily call native libraries, increasing code re-use.

key_features.title: Macros
key_features.content: Crystal's answer to metaprogramming is a powerful macro system.

about_content:
# About

Crystal is a compiled, object-oriented programming language.
These are some of the language's goals:

- Ruby-inspired syntax.

- Statically type-checked but without having to specify the type of variables or method arguments.

- Be able to call C code by writing bindings to it in Crystal.

- Have compile-time evaluation and generation of code, to avoid boilerplate code.

- Compile to efficient native code.
